hooks.name: vitana-workflow-watchdog-start
hooks.description: VTID-05337: at session start, report workflow runs of this workspace paused by an agent restart (or running with a stale heartbeat) and how to resume them. Read-only.

hooks.name: vitana-workflow-watchdog-prompt
hooks.description: VTID-05337: on each prompt, report this session's own paused or stale workflow runs. Read-only, silent when there are none.
